entry.summary: Since 23 April 2026, non-visa nationals arriving from outside the Common Travel Area need a UK ETA, which the UK runs for Jersey, Guernsey and the Isle of Man. Arriving from the UK, the UK ETA already covers it.
entry.max_stay: Up to 6 months as a visitor
entry.pre_arrival: Apply at gov.uk/eta/apply or the UK ETA app at least three working days before travel; £20 (about A$38 at RBA, 30 October 2026: A$1 = £0.5258).

seasons-and-flow.climate: Wettest: October, November and December. Driest: April, May and June. Hottest: August (14.8°C average). Coolest: February (5.3°C average). Country-wide averages for 1991 to 2020; coasts, mountains and the far north or south can differ a lot.

culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: No FCDO advice page exists for Isle of Man, and no official etiquette guidance has been checked yet. Ask locally. Visit Isle of Man: the custom when crossing the Fairy Bridge (A5 near Santon) is to greet the 'Little People' ('Hello Fairies', or in Manx 'Moghrey mie Vooinjer Veggey').
culture-and-protocol.cultural_authority: Isle of Man Government; Visit Isle of Man
culture-and-protocol.note: No official source read; the authority is named so it can be asked.
